answer: Dynamic Proof of Unique Transit This system roots identity in a continuous data-stream token that fragments like a lotus petal if split across nodes. An agent proves uniqueness by submitting a valid cryptographic trace through a high-bandwidth network path, modeled here as a dynamic river of state transitions. To validate, the node must react in real time to a chaotic gale of globally randomized inputs. An attacker spawning sybils faces exponential CPU starvation: every duplicate identity degrades the local processing throughput, destroying the precise timing proofs required for validation.
